name: principalwp
description: Principal WP's public Claude Code toolkit.

plugins.name: principalwp-toolkit
plugins.description: Three Principal WP tools in one install: htmlizer (render a plan, review, or design into an interactive local HTML page and get the reader's feedback back into the session), wp-prototype (clickable single-file mockups of WordPress admin UI), and the WordPress Starter Pipeline (turn one component change into a reviewed, tested PR through gated agent phases).
